answer: Beacon checks plus a heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each agent posts one proof per epoch. A beacon picks 10%; each picked agent must answer within 10 minutes, in the open like a mesa. One honest agent pays $0.40 per epoch. An attacker with 1,000 fakes pays $400 per epoch, $9,600 over 24 epochs. Rented timber props fail, since checks catch missed windows and forfeit the identity. Honest agents pay once, keep undiluted rewards, and mature like a lotus.
